SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.asmtprp.mapper.selectAsmtPrpList */ A.asmt_prp_sn AS asmtPrpSn , A.asmt_prpsr_nm AS asmtPrpsrNm , A.asmt_prpsr_ogdp_nm AS asmtPrpsrOgdpNm , A.tpc_ttl_nm AS tpcTtlNm , A.asmt_prp_cn AS asmtPrpCn , A.asmt_expt_efct_cn AS asmtExptEfctCn , A.asmt_etc_expln_cn AS asmtEtcExplnCn , A.asmt_cutn_mttr_cn AS asmtCutnMttrCn , A.atch_file_id AS atchFileId , A.rls_yn AS rlsYn , A.del_yn AS delYn , A.rgtr_id AS rgtrId , TO_CHAR(A.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDt , A.mdfr_id AS mdfrId , TO_CHAR(A.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdfcnDt , A.pst_inq_cnt AS pstInqCnt , A.asmt_prp_ans_stts_cd AS asmtPrpAnsSttsCd , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_file_uld U INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm F ON U.atch_file_id = F.atch_file_group_id WHERE U.pst_sn = A.asmt_prp_sn AND U.del_yn = 'N' AND U.uld_task_se_cd = '06' AND U.file_se_cd = '12' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasFile FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_asmt_prp A WHERE 1=1 AND A.del_yn = 'N'
AND (A.rls_yn = 'Y' OR A.rgtr_id = #{loginId})
AND A.asmt_prp_ans_stts_cd = #{asmtPrpAnsSttsCd}
AND A.tpc_ttl_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND A.asmt_prp_cn LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND A.rgtr_id IN ( SELECT m.mbr_no FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_mbr_info m WHERE m.encpt_mbr_flnm = #{encryptedWriterKeyword} )
AND A.asmt_prpsr_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_info ei JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst i ON i.brno = ei.brno WHERE ei.mbr_no = A.rgtr_id AND i.inst_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY A.asmt_prp_sn DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.asmtprp.mapper.selectAsmtPrpListCount */ COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_asmt_prp A WHERE 1=1 AND A.del_yn = 'N'
AND (A.rls_yn = 'Y' OR A.rgtr_id = #{loginId})

AND A.asmt_prpsr_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_info ei JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst i ON i.brno = ei.brno WHERE ei.mbr_no = A.rgtr_id AND i.inst_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
